events.title: Budget-Friendly Cosplaying 101
events.description: Learn the secrets of creating incredible cosplay on a budget with Carcali. Tips for sourcing materials, reusing items, and keeping your creativity high while costs stay low.

events.title: 4 Months With A 3D Printer: Practical Hyperfixation
events.description: A deep dive into the journey of 3D printing as a passionate hobby—exploring the challenges, learning curve, and exciting potential of personal fabrication.

events.title: Pious Dawn Fan Film
events.description: Behind-the-scenes insights into the making of the Pious Dawn fan film, including prop design, cinematography, and collaborative storytelling in the Warhammer universe.

events.title: Model Kit Speed Building
events.description: Watch skilled builders assemble detailed model kits against the clock. A fun and educational competition showcasing different building techniques and precision under pressure.

events.title: Introduction to Figure Painting
events.description: An introduction to the art of miniature and figure painting, focusing on layering, shading, and techniques to bring your models to life.

events.title: "Spaced Out" Original Comic Book Publication
events.description: Join comic creator Dave Zuppini for an exclusive look at the creation of 'Spaced Out', an independent comic celebrating creative storytelling and artistic independence.

events.title: Beyond the Hobby: How Pastimes Empower Self-Discovery
events.description: A heartfelt session exploring how creative hobbies like cosplay and modeling help build confidence, foster connection, and support personal growth.

events.title: Crazy Engineering of Zerebin Cosplay
events.description: A look into the inventive craftsmanship of Zerebin Cosplay—exploring engineering tricks, materials, and the artistry behind their most complex builds.

events.title: Thanks
events.stage: Brisbane Metro 1/14 RC Truck & Construction Club
events.description: Join the Brisbane Metro RC community for an interactive demonstration of scale model trucks and construction vehicles in action.

events.title: Categories A - K & Sponsor Show Stopper Award Announcements
events.description: The first round of category awards and sponsor prizes for outstanding modelers and creators at GHMX Expo.

events.title: Creating Comic and Gaming Worlds in a Galaxy Far, Far Away
events.description: A creative discussion with Adam and Wayne Nichols about crafting narrative universes that bridge gaming, comics, and pop culture.

events.title: Categories L - Z Award Announcements
events.description: The concluding segment of the GHMX awards ceremony, featuring the final category winners and special recognitions.

events.title: Get Sprued! Model Kit Trivia
events.description: Test your modeling knowledge with a fun and fast-paced trivia challenge. Expect laughs, learning, and prizes for the sharpest hobby minds.

events.title: Major Award Ceremony
events.description: Celebrate the grand finale of GHMX with the major awards presentation, honoring creativity, craftsmanship, and community spirit.
